title: When and why can integral constraints improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks?
abstract: arXiv:2611.25515v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adding constraints obtained by integrating governing equations to the loss has been reported to improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in several applications, but mathematical understanding of these benefits remains limited. For several partial differential equations (PDEs), we derive stability estimates for losses with and without integral constraints. The comparison reveals that in certain parameter regimes, the standard loss has very weak control over specific error components, and that the integral constraints restore uniform control of these components. This explains when and why the constraints improve accuracy. Finally, numerical experiments support this interpretation. In parameter regimes where the standard loss is predicted to have weak control over those components, the two losses indeed show clear differences in accuracy. translated_title: 积分约束何时以及为何能够提高物理信息神经网络的精度？
translated_abstract: 在损失函数中加入通过对控制方程进行积分所得到的约束，已被报道可以在若干应用中提高物理信息神经网络（PINN）的精度，但对这些益处的数学理解仍然有限。对于若干偏微分方程（PDE），我们推导了带积分约束与不带积分约束的损失函数的稳定性估计。通过比较发现，在某些参数范围内，标准损失对特定误差分量的控制非常弱，而积分约束恢复了对这些分量的一致控制。这解释了积分约束何时以及为何能够提高精度。最后，数值实验支持了这一解释。在预测标准损失对这些分量控制较弱的参数范围内，两种损失在精度上确实表现出明显差异；相反，在标准损失仍保持足够控制的参数范围内……
tldr: 该论文通过推导带与不带积分约束的PINN损失函数的稳定性估计，从数学上揭示了积分约束在特定参数范围内通过恢复标准损失对弱控制误差分量的一致控制来提升精度的机理与适用条件。
en_tdlr: This paper derives stability estimates for PINN losses with and without integral constraints, mathematically explaining when and why integral constraints improve accuracy by restoring uniform control over specific error components that the standard loss controls only weakly in certain parameter regimes.
